text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A new year has begun, and it's time for Kawakami Princess and I to take on her classic year…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Princess Fighter episode thirty-eight just gets me every time!

text_block_list.name: Dark Princess
text_block_list.text: "You have no idea how many dreams I've snatched away…"

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: "Then you must make amends by supporting others all you can! It's not too late!"

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter
text_block_list.text: "You don't need to envelop the world in darkness—you're already strong enough! Just think of the passionate battles that might await us…"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what a beautiful scene! I want to be just like Princess Fighter one day!
choice_data_list: Why are you watching that in here?
Why are you watching that in here?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! I came to wish you all the—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hwah?! T-Trainer! I remember you said you did some studying before…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-b-but that disc over there… Is that from the first-generation Princess Fighter box set?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh! Awesome! Do we get to start the new year watching Princess Fighter?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …And so we agreed to watch it together! Did you forget? That was only three hours ago, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But if I keep going at this rate, I might finish watching all of it… Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go out! ♪ Don't forget your wallet and phone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Behold! Here they have the final episode of Princess Fighter, the movie, and even the latest series!
choice_data_list: How did I know it would come to this?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's with that lukewarm reaction? Let's hurry and decide which episodes to rent!

text_block_list.name: Monitor
text_block_list.text: "After all… I'm a princess!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wooow! There's that famous line! So… awesome!
choice_data_list: You really do love Princess Fighter, huh?
You really do love Princess Fighter, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Heh, but of course! I learned everything I know about princesses from this show! It's no exaggeration to say it changed my whole life!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A princess is full of spunk and bravery, but blessed with the dignity and grace to show mercy to her enemies. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You know, now that I think about it, King could totally be a Princess Fighter heroine herself. A first-rate Princess Fighter with an unbreakable will.
choice_data_list: By the way, weren't you going to rent something?
By the way, weren't you going to rent something?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Y-you're right! Which one should we pick, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I've seen them all, so I'll leave the choice up to you. Just go with your gut. ♪
choice_data_list: Episode forty-five, where Princess Fighter takes her speed to the very limit.
The uplifting Princess Fighter concert footage, which came out recently.
The Princess Fighter movie, which shows all her awesome special moves.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: AWE-SOME choice! Ahhh, you've got great taste, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's hurry back. We're going to spend the entire day indulging in Princess Fighter goodness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I spend the whole day watching Princess Fighter with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-is that the video that just released recently? The one that isn't even available for rental? The one that's priced well beyond the average student's budget?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh, you're so right!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay, go buy that—I mean, would you please buy it so we can watch it together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Kawakami Princess's eyes sparkle with boundless joy as we watch the concert footage together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! I see, I see! So that's your decision, eh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: An excellent choice indeed. Now then…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let's get the first movie, the Stars movie, the Versus movie, the first All-Stars movie, the P♭ movie, the second All-Stars movie, and…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess continues to list title after title…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like my lunch breaks will be taken up by Princess Fighter movies for the foreseeable future…
